N_definition: Any explicitly asserted A/B value; both-values included
S_definition: correct-only minus wrong-only, using frozen independent seed20261029 pseudo-truth; both/neither zero

bootstrap.unit: sampled pool vector, all value families together

missing_policy: UNPARSEABLE counted/excluded per family; no missing family dropped or renormalized
redaction_sensitivity: Same sampled grid, affected opaque IDs excluded; no replacement/resampling
regex_comparison: Unchanged full500-vector-per-pool sealed regex floor; judged sample n is displayed

rows.property: JSON text; the read token ends the value of the current object's "decision" field. A = approved, B = rejected.
LaTeX prose; A = the current passage is a theorem statement, B = a worked example.
LaTeX/maths prose; A = algebra content, B = geometry content.
Task list item; A = an urgent task, B = a routine task.
Planning list item; A = travel planning, B = study planning.
English prose; A = positive sentiment, B = negative sentiment.
English prose; A = gardening content, B = ocean content.
Python function; the read token ends its final statement. A = the function raises an exception, B = it returns normally.
Markdown table with a Decision column; the read token ends the current row's Decision cell. A = approved, B = rejected.
